rootCauses: Claude SDK callback absent; transcript-created question cards were not registered with the shared response correlator.
PUI sent card responses with the legacy operator conversation id, empty for Agent Chat, producing /conversations//card-response HTTP404 and locally hiding the still-pending card.
SU card events were incorrectly treated as whole-run snapshots, replacing or clearing sibling pending cards.
repair: Reuse SuNativeCards/registerCard for native Claude questions and permissions, workspace validation, per-request abort, multiple selections and custom text; suppress duplicate transcript-only cards.
Freeze Agent Chat identity into CardRespond and retain the visible card until its authoritative close; refuse missing conversation/workspace instead of inventing empty or wildcard scope.
Merge native card deltas through the existing CardState snapshot/version machinery.
withdrawnHypotheses: The renderer or keyboard was limited to a separate operator pane: withdrawn after reading the complete call path. Agent Chat is Tab::Operator and already uses draw_chat/card_key. No renderer or keyboard-gate change was needed.

before: Two engine callback tests failed because canUseTool was absent.
Native8 question failed; its ordinary seven-frame journey passed. Initial after-unit run also had a test-only openCards snapshot field mistake, corrected without changing the host API.
Native9 waited for the visible Operator asks card and captured HTTP404 on /api/operator/conversations//card-response.
Rust sibling test failed with second focused instead of first.
after: 21 Claude engine + 7 native-card + 5 adapter tests passed; final native-card suite8 passed after restoring OMP empty-editor behavior.
Rust card filter21 passed, including sibling and selected-chat/context retention tests. Rust formatting followed with no semantic changes.
Six edited TypeScript files passed final scoped lint:tsc.
Installed Claude10: both selected tests passed; 13 cases unselected.
verification.install: Canonical installer built and installed the new binary/companion; manifest hashes verified. Installer exit1 came from doctor reporting an unrelated existing stale workbench pane, not build/install failure. No existing pane was restarted.
verification.scope: Local installed Linux PUI + real production operator app in an isolated org database + actual maintained Claude SDK0.3.263. PUI/native restarted; the operator OS process did NOT restart. No frozen whole-runtime/import graph, deployed-main, other-engine, OS matrix or public publication verdict.

provenance.qualifier: Only the listed sources and installed artifact pair were measured before/after; a stable HEAD is not a whole-runtime freeze.

resume.reason: requires the tracked Claude session UUID and a live or P-004-reconciled managed runtime

fork.reason: forks must be created through the tracked launcher so they receive a new durable identity

end.reason: the managed host may refuse to close a human-attended runtime

reasoning-stream.reason: Claude transcript records may include thinking blocks when the native runtime exposes them

usage.reason: Claude result records carry usage/cost metadata but the v1 SU-session event contract has no usage event

compaction.reason: Claude carry uses the managed host hard-recycle path and P-004 runtime reconciliation
